ui.locked: Complete a government building of tier {required} or higher in a settlement you own, then resolve a season. Best completed tier: {current}. Queued work does not count.
ui.qualifying: Your completed civic seat qualifies. Lucius will join after the season resolves.
ui.available: Lucius joined your council at {settlement} in turn {turn}. His counsel remains available after later losses.
ui.battle: Council availability and city readings are checked again after the battle view closes.
ui.no_seat: No owned government building is reported yet.
ui.permanent: Existing qualifying campaigns welcome him at creation or when an older save is first loaded.

reading.heading: A reading of your city
reading.source: These are the game’s reported factors, read when you open this page. This written reading is not an AI reply. Connect to ask Lucius what the tradeoffs mean.
reading.battle: Economic reports are unavailable while the battle view is open. Return after the battle to read your city.
reading.no_selection: Select one of your own settlements on the map, or enter owned Roma, then return here. Lucius cannot read another faction’s administration.
reading.survey: Societal report: {level} · {turns} seasons old. Missing figures are unknown, not zero.
reading.limited: Only the first {limit} factors are listed. Inspect the settlement panel for the complete breakdown.
